title: ForceTick Server
description: Server-side mod that forces chunks to tick without players nearby
body:
# ForceTick Server

**A server-side Fabric mod that forces chunks to tick without players nearby. Perfect for automatic farms!**

## ✨ Features

- **100% Server-side** - No client mod required!
- **Forced Chunk Loading** - Keeps chunks loaded even without players nearby
- **Automatic Random Ticks** - Crops grow automatically (sugar cane, cactus, bamboo, etc.)
- **Full Farm Support** - Works with observers, pistons, hoppers, items on water, chests, and more!
- **Persistent Storage** - Chunks stay forced after server restart
- **Simple Commands** - Easy to use in-game commands
- **Lightweight** - Minimal performance impact

## 🎮 Commands

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `/forcetick add` | Force-tick the chunk you're standing in |
| `/forcetick add <x> <z>` | Force-tick a specific chunk by coordinates |
| `/forcetick remove` | Remove force-tick from current chunk |
| `/forcetick remove <x> <z>` | Remove force-tick from specific chunk |
| `/forcetick list` | List all force-ticked chunks in current dimension |
| `/forcetick removeall` | Remove all force-ticked chunks in current dimension |

**Requires OP permission level 2**

## 🌾 How It Works

Based on the proven concept from FXNT Chunks by foxynotail.

**The Technique:**
1. **Chunk Forced Loading** - Uses `setChunkForced()` to keep chunks loaded
2. **Manual Random Ticks** - Applies random ticks to blocks for crop growth

**What Works Automatically When Chunk Is Forced:**
- ✅ Sugar cane farms (observers + pistons + hoppers)
- ✅ Cactus farms
- ✅ Bamboo farms
- ✅ Item collection systems
- ✅ Hopper processing
- ✅ Redstone contraptions
- ✅ Block entities (chests, hoppers, etc.)
- ✅ Entity ticking (items on water, mobs)

## 📦 Requirements

- Minecraft 1.20.1
- Fabric Loader 0.15.0+
- Fabric API

## 🔧 Installation

1. Install Fabric Loader on your server
2. Install Fabric API mod
3. Download ForceTick Server and place it in your `mods` folder
4. Start your server!

## 💾 Data Storage

Force-ticked chunks are automatically saved and will persist across server restarts. Data is stored in your world folder.
